18-20 | You leave footprints that glow with an otherworldly light for the next hour.
21-23 | Your jump distance is tripled for 1 minute.
24-26 | You manifest disguise self, taking on the appearance of the nearest humanoid.

51-53 | Up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you take 4d10 psychic damage.

60-62 | You manifest sleep at the level of the spell that triggered this surge targeting yourself.

66-68 | You manifest grease centered on yourself.
69-71 | You are frightened by the nearest creature until the end of your next turn.
72-74 | You resist all damage for the next minute.
75-77 | You manifest hypnotic pattern centered on you. This spell does not require concentration.
78-80 | For the next minute, you regain 5 Psi Points at the start of each of your turns.
